name: hug knees to chest
description: Lie on your back and gently hug both knees toward your chest to stretch the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Bring both knees toward your chest and wrap your arms around your shins.
Gently draw your knees closer until you feel a comfortable stretch across the glutes and lower back.
Breathe steadily, then release your legs slowly.
